$comment: Design-to-authoring visual generation contract. Enforced by scripts/check_visual_type_contract.py. Generation targets must match power-bi-report-authoring policy; legacy types stay readable but are never generated.
notes: cardVisual is the current first-party card (data role 'Data', supports referenceLabel/cardCalloutArea/smallMultiples). 'card' is the legacy single-value visual (role 'Values').
azureMap replaces the deprecated Bing 'map' and 'filledMap'.
Legacy types remain readable when importing existing reports; they are never emitted by a recipe.
